My boardroom philosophy: eyes in, hands out.

I'm not a networker with a Rolodex or an advisor who recommends and walks away. I'm the navigator who reads the conditions honestly and calls the course correction — while you keep both hands on the wheel.

I help visionary founders and C-suites run their most critical operations. Not advisory — true partnership, sweat equity and owner mindset.

WHAT I DO

For startups: Tech and product strategy built for enterprise scale from day one — not retrofitting compliance and security when you're closing a large deal. For everything else, I'm your sounding board — guardrails, direction, and conversations that find solutions.

For growth-stage / IPO-ready companies: One critical strategic function — pressure-testing the bets and holding management accountable for the ones that move the needle.

For large enterprises: Entrepreneurial operator mentality on established boards. Rigorous enterprise tech understanding + willingness to challenge the status quo.

HOW I WORK

1. I see what's hard to see from inside
Leadership teams are often too close to their own blind spots. I flag the real bottleneck and hold the team accountable for closing it.

2. I challenge, not validate
If you're wrong, I'll tell you. If you're right but thinking too small, I'll push you. Boards that only nod aren't boards — they're audiences.

3. I bring pattern recognition, not war stories
Building and scaling companies taught me what separates real product-market fit from good execution chasing the wrong market. I bring that judgment to the table.

4. My incentives are aligned with yours
I hold equity, not just an opinion. If the strategy fails, I feel it too. That alignment separates a true partner from an advisor who collects a fee and moves on.

5. I hold rigor over rhetoric
I ask for the data behind the confidence. If something isn't working, I'll say so — no political softening.

WHO I WORK WITH

• Founders playing the long game — building something durable, not flipping for a quick multiple
• Teams that earn trust the hard way (real client relationships, real revenue)
• Leaders who take care of the people who build the company with them
• Companies where tech and operations are core to the bet, not an afterthought

Open to board seats and select fractional operating roles.
